summary.en: A person who changed their surname on marriage and wants to keep it after divorce files a "notification to continue using the name used during marriage" at the same time as the divorce or within 3 months after it (to be checked). It is separate from the divorce registration (to be checked). After 3 months, permission from the family court is needed. This is for people with a Japanese family register. How a foreign national handles their home-country name is outside this card; ask at the counter (to be checked).

text.en: The citizens' section of the ward office, or branch office, for your registered domicile or current address
